# Reedito support

This source distribution does not have a Reedito-operated support forum,
documentation site, or paid support plan. Read the repository's local
documentation first. For behavior inherited from Ghost, the upstream
[Ghost documentation](https://docs.ghost.org/) and
[community forum](https://forum.ghost.org/) may help; they describe the
upstream project and may not cover Reedito-specific changes.

Report reproducible bugs through the issue tracker of the GitHub repository
where you obtained this source. Do not send credentials, API keys, or private
member data in an issue.
